editions.title: EDITION G1: GROUP TEST 1 // TRANSMISSION 01
editions.chapter: Curated Style Chapter — Liquid Chrome & Tectonic Strata
editions.conceptSummary: Complete 15-post event announcement campaign curated exclusively from the user's Group 1 (39 style-matched artworks). High-tension liquid mercury spires, horizontal razor-sheared chrome strata, and molten crimson acoustic accents configured as an authentic underground techno party rollout.

editions.title: EDITION 01: HYDRAULIC VOID
editions.conceptSummary: High-tension sculptural liquid chrome forms paired with planar razor-sheared laminar strata and brutalist fluid terraces. Zero translucent glass, zero pearlescent fluid, zero floating globes or rings. High contrast, photorealistic fluid metallic quality.

editions.title: EDITION 02: VITREOUS RESONANCE
editions.chapter: Chapter II — Nacreous Silk & Optical Glass
editions.conceptSummary: Velvety nacreous pearlescent fluid swells interwoven with gossamer-thin optical glass membranes and delicate cyan/lavender caustic refractions. A lighter, hypnotic, ethereal techno chapter.

editions.title: EDITION 03: TOROIDAL FLUX
editions.chapter: Chapter III — Orbital Annuli & Kinetic Loops
editions.conceptSummary: Nested elliptical liquid chrome rings, circular capillary standing wave ripples, and distorted toroidal apertures suspended in deep vacuum void.

editions.title: EDITION 04: TECTONIC SHEAR
editions.chapter: Chapter IV — Obsidian Terraces & Brutalist Faults
editions.conceptSummary: Monolithic stepped obsidian terraces, brutalist planar fluid faults, razor-creased metallic drapery, and high-tensile chrome ribbons engineered for deep, raw percussive techno rhythms.

editions.title: EDITION 06: ORBITAL ANNULUS
editions.chapter: Chapter VI — Concentric Torus & Vitreous Spheres
editions.conceptSummary: Nested liquid mercury rings, levitating optic silica globes, and kinetic toroidal apertures refracting the dark void for futuristic, fast polyrhythmic techno excursions.

editions.title: EDITION 07: CHROMATIC STRATA
editions.chapter: Chapter VII — Tiered Chromatic Rows (Silver / Red / Cyan / Purple / Amber)
editions.conceptSummary: Horizontal chromatic strata across the 3-column Instagram profile grid: Row 1 Silver Mercury, Row 2 Molten Crimson, Row 3 Cryogenic Cyan, Row 4 Ultraviolet Purple, Row 5 Solar Amber.

editions.title: EDITION 11: VERTICAL MONOLITH
editions.conceptSummary: A striking vertical architecture across the 3-column Instagram profile feed: Left Column in Pure Silver/Obsidian, Center Column in Molten Crimson, and Right Column in Electric Ultraviolet.

editions.title: EDITION 15: INVERTED PLATINUM
editions.chapter: Chapter XV — Inverted High-Contrast Platinum Mercury
editions.conceptSummary: High-contrast inverted platinum liquid mercury alternating with pitch-black void monoliths and precision laser red/cyan telemetry stamps for stark, brutalist underground techno.

editions.title: EDITION 17: NACREOUS STRATA
editions.chapter: Chapter XVII — Topographic Faults & Nacreous Silk
editions.conceptSummary: Brutalist planar fluid shelves and stepped tectonic fault terraces rendered in soft diffuse nacreous silver luster and velvety fluid silk.

editions.title: EDITION 18: TOROIDAL FAULT
editions.chapter: Chapter XVIII — Kinetic Annuli & Sheared Tectonic Terraces
editions.conceptSummary: Concentric toroidal liquid chrome rings and capillary standing wave ripples shearing through stepped brutalist fluid terraces and planar obsidian faults.

editions.title: ARCHIVE: OMNI-SPECTRUM (ORIGINAL)
editions.conceptSummary: The initial exploratory campaign generation sampling across all 77 approved masters indiscriminately prior to artwork-family partitioning.
